records.Concise description: U.S. Bitcoin-focused brokerage combining BTC execution, custodial balances, withdrawals, and Bitcoin wallet functionality.
records.Deeper researched summary: River is a Bitcoin-focused financial platform founded in 2019. Customers can buy bitcoin, keep it in River-controlled custody, or withdraw on-chain; the current wallet also supports Lightning sends and receives. River publishes monthly proofs covering identified reserve assets and an anonymized liabilities set, while separately publishing company financial statements. MSC should describe that program as River's proof-of-reserves process—not as a blanket third-party guarantee of solvency.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2019. River has expanded from Bitcoin brokerage and custody into wallet, recurring-buy, private-client and cash-account services while remaining Bitcoin-focused.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: River is a durable U.S. example of a Bitcoin-only custodial brokerage that pairs institutional-style custody with straightforward self-custody withdrawals and unusually explicit reserve/liability disclosures.
Important technical or cultural characte: Custodial while BTC remains on River
Monthly proof of assets and liabilities
Public financial statements are separate from proof of reserves
records.Verification basis: Current River About, Wallet, Proof of Reserves and Public Financials pages verify active operation, founder, custody/withdrawal model and the scope of River's reserve disclosures.
Research notes / uncertainties: Proof of reserves is not identical to proof of corporate solvency; River itself distinguishes reserve proofs from broader financial statements.
Product availability and cash-account terms vary by jurisdiction and should be rechecked before public copy.

records.Exchanges subtopic: Bitcoin-focused brokerage interface with third-party custody
records.Concise description: Bitcoin-focused purchase and savings platform whose current terms position Swan as a technology interface to third-party trading and custody providers.
records.Deeper researched summary: Swan Bitcoin started in 2019 with recurring Bitcoin purchases and has expanded into private-client, retirement, treasury and collaborative-custody services. Its July 17, 2026 terms are unusually important for custody accuracy: Swan says it is solely a technology provider and does not itself custody customer fiat or bitcoin in the ordinary brokerage flow; customers transact through authorized third-party custodians. That makes Swan materially different from a brokerage that directly controls client keys.
records.Launch / history: Started in 2019. Swan developed around recurring Bitcoin accumulation and later expanded into private-client, retirement, treasury and custody-related offerings.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Swan is a prominent Bitcoin-only accumulation platform and a useful case study in separating the consumer-facing brokerage brand from the underlying regulated trading/custody providers.
Important technical or cultural characte: Third-party custodian execution/custody in current terms
Collaborative-custody offerings are distinct from ordinary brokerage custody
records.Verification basis: Swan's July 2026 terms verify the platform/custodian separation; Swan's current team page verifies Cory Klippsten and the 2019 start.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not write that Swan itself is the custodian for ordinary brokerage balances; current terms expressly separate Swan's technology role from third-party custodians.
Custodian identity and availability can change; public copy should not freeze a provider name without re-verification.

records.Entity / project type: Custodial Bitcoin app / broker / payments platform
records.Concise description: Bitcoin and payments app that lets users buy, hold, send, receive, and withdraw BTC over on-chain Bitcoin and Lightning.
records.Deeper researched summary: Strike combines brokerage and payments in one custodial account. Strike's own education material explicitly describes Strike as a custodial wallet because it handles private keys on users' behalf until bitcoin is withdrawn. Current product material supports buying bitcoin in-app plus on-chain and Lightning movement. The canonical home is EXCHANGES because BTC execution is a core product, while payments and wallet behavior should remain cross-category relationships rather than duplicate profiles.
records.Launch / history: Strike emerged publicly in 2020 from Zap's Lightning work and developed into a Bitcoin trading and payments app with international expansion.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Strike helped normalize Lightning-connected Bitcoin buying and movement inside a mainstream mobile product while keeping direct withdrawal to self-custody available.
Important technical or cultural characte: Custodial account while funds remain on Strike
records.Verification basis: Current Strike first-party education explicitly identifies Strike as custodial and describes self-custody withdrawals; current product pages verify active Bitcoin and Lightning functionality.
Research notes / uncertainties: Strike spans EXCHANGES, PAYMENTS and WALLETS; this registry treats the entity once and models the other roles relationally.
Licensing statements must be jurisdiction-specific; do not write simply that Strike is 'regulated everywhere'.

records.Concise description: Bitcoin-only brokerage and payment service built around direct settlement to or from user-controlled Bitcoin wallets rather than exchange-account custody.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bull Bitcoin operates as principal counterparty for Bitcoin purchase/sale flows in supported markets and emphasizes non-custodial settlement: users provide their own Bitcoin, Lightning or Liquid wallet rather than leaving a trading balance with Bull Bitcoin. The company also offers merchant/payment conversion features and a self-custody wallet product. Its regulatory footprint is market-specific and changed materially in 2026, so any MiCA or national-license language must be dated and tied to the relevant operating entity.
records.Launch / history: Bull Bitcoin traces its Canadian Bitcoin brokerage lineage to the 2010s and has expanded into Europe, Costa Rica and Mexico while keeping a Bitcoin-only, self-custody-oriented model.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It represents a distinctive dealer/broker model: fiat-to-BTC and BTC-to-fiat execution without making an exchange custodial balance the center of the product.
Important technical or cultural characte: On-chain, Lightning and Liquid-related payment flows in supported products
records.Verification basis: Current Bull Bitcoin first-party product and regional-launch material verifies active Bitcoin-only operation, founder and direct-to-wallet/non-custodial positioning.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not use 'non-custodial' to imply zero counterparty/execution risk; Bull Bitcoin is still a contractual counterparty during exchange/payment execution.
European regulatory statements changed in 2026 and should be rechecked against the competent-authority registry immediately before publication.
